# Spring Health

> > Spring Health provides comprehensive mental health solutions for employers, offering precision mental healthcare, clinical navigation, and workplace wellbeing programs.

Spring Health delivers evidence-based mental health benefits including therapy, coaching, medication management, and specialized support for conditions like ADHD, PTSD, and postpartum depression. The platform serves enterprise clients like General Mills, DocuSign, and Bain with global EAP services and personalized care matching.

## Key Topics

- Precision Mental Healthcare
- Workplace Wellbeing
- Employee Assistance Programs (EAP)
- HR Leadership & Strategy
- Anxiety Management
- Telehealth & Teletherapy
- BIPOC Mental Health
- Neurodiversity (ADHD, Autism)
- Employee Engagement
- Mental Health Benefits ROI
- COVID-19 Workplace Support
- Postpartum Depression
- Career Coaching
- Inclusive Workplace Culture
- Therapist Provider Network

- [Neurodiversity Support](https://www.springhealth.com/what-we-do-old/neurodiversity): Neurodiversity support with specialized care for ADHD, autism, and more

## Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

- [Supporting BIPOC Mental Health: Addressing Microaggressions in the Workplace](https://www.springhealth.com/blog/supporting-bipoc-mental-health-addressing-microaggressions): Guide to addressing workplace microaggressions and BIPOC mental health
- [What to Say and Do in the Aftermath of Racial Violence](https://www.springhealth.com/blog/how-to-support-employees-racial-violence): HR guidance for supporting employees after racial violence trauma
